mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy shift that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 30 days, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings prospects, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in 60% or more of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 growth rate negative), a decline in industrial production signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO declines and GDPC1 growth is negative, or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0), or the signal's Rank IC < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate output and profits, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of instances where INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payroll employment signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate signals a monetary policy response to a deteriorating economy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative 5-day returns in 60% or more of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03.
